hints.title: Prefix Window Offset
hints.text: Indices i <= j - indexDifference form a valid prefix pool whose bounds expand as j increases.

hints.title: Extrema Indices Tracking
hints.text: Maintain the index of the minimum value and the index of the maximum value within that valid prefix.

hints.title: Linear Search
hints.text: For each j, check whether nums[j] forms a valid difference with either the prefix min or the prefix max in O(1) time.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass with O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) nested loop times out for n = 100,000.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use running prefix min/max pointer to achieve O(n) time and O(1) space.
